To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the CRISTA water vapor mixing ratio data set provides a unique global picture of the water vapor distribution at the tropopause.
CRISTA water vapor measurements at the tropopause show a large amount of structure, which is related to gravity waves, and that the CRISTA measurements are consistent with the Version 4.8 MLS data.

(i) the CRISTA water vapor mixing ratios are in good agreement with in situ measurements and with the Version 4.0 climatology of the MLS instrument; (ii) the CRISTA data show a high variability of water vapor mixing ratios at 15 km altitude; and (iii) the CRISTA RH is in good agreement with the UKMO RH.
